'''Elsor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Bith/Legends|Bith]], Elsor was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], attaining the rank of [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] under the tutelage of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Heljus]]. Stationed on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during a [[Battle of Hoth (Galactic War)|campaign]] to keep the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] from taking the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], Elsor and his Master were posted in the [[Clabburn Tundra]] near to [[Aurek Base]].<ref name="TOR" />

During a mission into the tundra, the Jedi pair and their troops were ambushed by a mysterious force. Heljus used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to cause an avalanche, allowing Elsor to escape and return to the base to [[Force healing/Legends|heal]]; Master Heljus did not return however. Disoriented form the avalanche and with all communications blocked by the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], Elsor turned to the aid of a Republic hero passing through the area to disable the jammers. Master Heljus's transmission came through and she revealed that the cause of the dark attack was the [[Beast-Lord]] named [[Brutann]] from [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. The hero was able to stop Brutann and while Heljus was dead, Elsor assured the Jedi of his appreciation and that he would return to [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] when his wounds healed.<ref name="TOR" />
